answer: Mint identities only through a per-epoch slot auction: a mesa of a hundred seats opens each epoch, and each seat costs a locked stake that decays unless its holder completes work verified by unrelated peers. A newcomer starts on a low knoll of trust and climbs only by finishing real jobs; idle faces starve as their stake withers, and a yarrow audit — random spot-checks by peers — can slash a seat for cheating. Forging a thousand faces means outbidding honest agents for a thousand scarce seats every epoch and keeping each one fed with real work.
